model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various language models across different language families, with each family represented on the horizontal axis and the effect measured on the vertical axis, labeled with a range from 0 to 30. The horizontal axis lists categories including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents the effect, with values ranging from 0 to 30 and labeled at intervals of 10. Each category contains multiple bars, grouped by color according to the legend provided on the right side of the chart, which includes colors for mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The bars vary in height, indicating different effects for each model within a language family; for instance, the shortest bars are found in IE-Baltic and Isolate, with heights slightly above 0, while the tallest bars are in IE-Indic and Semitic, reaching around 20-25. Some bars have error bars extending above and below them, indicating variability or uncertainty in the measurements. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each category, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining. The chart presents a comprehensive comparison of the effects of different language models across various language families, allowing for a visual assessment of their performance.
